lead: A handler closure in `nvs-cli` takes its parameter type from its first statement, and the annotation cannot be spelled from `hyper`.
body: `move |request| { … }` compiles only because `table.select(&request, &OnDisk)` pins it to `Request<Incoming>`; a read placed above that line is `E0282: type annotations needed`, and `nvs-cli` has no `hyper` dependency on purpose (`rule:packaging/a-c-dependency-answers-two-questions`). Annotate the parameter with `nvs_server`'s re-exported `Request` and `Incoming` rather than reordering the body.
